import json,os
demo={"input":[[6,5,5],[5,1,7],[4,5,2]],"output":[[6,6,5,5,5],[6,6,5,5,5],[5,5,1,7,7],[4,4,5,2,2],[4,4,5,2,2]]}
def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    mn=min(min(r) for r in g)
    rh=[1 if mn in row else 2 for row in g]
    cw=[1 if mn in [g[i][j] for i in range(h)] else 2 for j in range(w)]
    out=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(g):
        orow=[]
        for j,v in enumerate(row):
            orow+= [v]*cw[j]
        for _ in range(rh[i]): out.append(orow[:])
    return out
print(transform(demo['input'])==demo['output'])
test=[[1,2,5],[7,3,6],[7,6,5]]
print(json.dumps(transform(test)))
